observation_summary: Emily Prime task: use RSI to improve the entity graph stuff
actions_taken: Three entity-graph RSI improvements: (1) Fixed broker_nonvote_anomaly to emit once per filing instead of once per director — previously N identical signals per election polluted the signal store since all nominees share the same BNV count. New signal ID is per-filing with no entity field. (2) Added new abstention_outlier signal type: ScoreAbstentionOutliers detects directors whose abstain rate exceeds 2.5x the filing median AND 1% absolute floor — catches targeted protest voting directed at specific directors. Added to AllSignalTypes and GovernanceHealth penalty table. (3) Added isSpuriousName() function to parser.go to filter persisted spurious nodes (Against Abstained, Broker Non-Vote) from nodes.ndjson on load and compaction without requiring manual data migration. Also created .env.example file and updated .gitignore to track it. Also updated IDUNA README to mark all implementation checklist items complete (they were done in prior commits but checklist was stale). Also wired Gmail CEO escalation into EMILY Prime's prime-triage loop with deduplication via cursor file.
notes: Also made cross-repo improvements: IDUNA README checklist updated (dc08e40), EMILY Prime Gmail escalation wired (5c40ce1). All three repos pushed to origin. Full test suite passes in PRRJECT_FATBABY and EMILY.
